scope: Independent movable furniture, bag storage/replacement, and whole-layout persistence
implemented: Nine owned furniture instances using eight transparent sprites and an empty architectural background
Floor furniture and wall pictures have separate placement domains
Store moves placement into the furniture bag without removing ownership; replace creates a validated draft
Done atomically saves bowl and furniture; Cancel restores the whole draft
Missing schema-1 furniture fields receive defaults; explicit empty arrays remain empty
Current furniture footprints participate in walking, food docking and play navigation
Dragging remains a geometry-only preview; route validation runs on a cancellable worker
The arrangement panel retains the normal room viewport; a real resize restarts a new-item placement safely

geometry.findings: All default footprints are inside their domain, mutually separated, and clear of cat and bowl; feeding is reachable without moving either cat or bowl.

intermediateValidation.note: Earlier default cushion/stool positions; one initial accessibility-identifier failure was fixed before these runs. Final source runs are listed separately.

art.runtimeRegistration: SpriteKit UV crops derived from transparency; original generated PNGs preserved.

device.launch: physical-device acceptance subsequently passed, confirmed by the user

limits: Food bowl remains a separate draggable object and is not reclaimable into the furniture bag.
